subject.title: fix(release): bind npm publishing to approved package bytes

question: After the PR cites the executed exact-head focused release-test transcript, is non-publishing validation sufficient for this npm publication-boundary change, or is a controlled live publish required?
rationale: Static review and focused tests support correctness, but only a release owner can accept the residual gap between simulated validation and irreversible OIDC npm publication.

options.title: Accept exact-head non-publishing proof
options.body: Update the evidence citation and land after a release manager confirms the focused workflow, artifact, and registry-readiness coverage is sufficient.

options.title: Require controlled publish proof
options.body: Pause until an approved prerelease or equivalent publication demonstrates OIDC publishing and registry integrity readback end to end.

recommendation.title: Accept exact-head non-publishing proof
recommendation.body: Update the evidence citation and land after a release manager confirms the focused workflow, artifact, and registry-readiness coverage is sufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main and branch history ties him directly to immutable release evidence and the publication boundary, and he authored the final reviewed head.
